title: Prove the exact 60-call full signed ternary connector optimum (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact **60 complete-call optimum** for all 26 nonzero coefficient rows in `{-1,0,1}^3`, over any characteristic-zero field, with three immutable sources, one dirty connector and signed source/readout calls. Claim type: scoped written mathematical proof with finite exact corroboration. No new κ.

```text
separate restored words: 108 source calls + 52 readouts = 160
shared cube cycle:         8 source calls + 52 readouts =  60
```

The all-word lower bound permits arbitrary extra target reads. Six source calls expose at most six vertices of a reflected unit cube. The eight full-support rows require all four antipodal pairs, so at least two rows need extra reads. Such words cost at least 62; every longer restored source word costs at least 60. An explicit eight-call cube cycle attains 60.

Only `research/full-signed-ternary-three/` is added. Produced by Nick Petalas. Ross Richardson's #944 supplies the signed interface and prefix criterion; #934/#943, shhxera/CubeJerry #889 and Chafik Boukhalfa #628 retain credit. Their classifications and scientific certificates are cited, not replayed. The new quantity is the complete 26x3 demand, rather than a fixed three-output obstruction, a replicated canonical matrix, or a prime-field two-source family.

## Evidence

Both registered checks and the direct verifier pass locally, with identical generated, source-hash-bound receipts under normal and optimized CPython 3.12. The two registered commands took 0.0469 and 0.0456 seconds locally, against individual 60-second limits. These durations are checks, not performance comparisons.

- Exact formal coefficient action checks both the 60-call word and the 160-call comparator, including arbitrary incoming connector dirt.
- All 247 cube subsets of size at most six satisfy the antipodal bound.
- 24 dense dirty-input executions at widths 2, 3 and 4 check singular/noncommuting maps and complete inverse round trips.
- 125 controls reject all single-call omissions, all sign flips and five malformed events.
- Registered metadata/source pins and committed-byte/source-history checks pass. The latter covers all five package files and base `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`.
- The card's first working example and selected-source metadata baseline passed as orientation. They are not new results or supplier replays.

Reproduce from the repository root using the standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/full-signed-ternary-three/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/full-signed-ternary-three/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/full-signed-ternary-three
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/full-signed-ternary-three --check-source-history
```

A reviewer may replace the absolute interpreter path with another CPython 3.12 executable. Expected markers: `PASS_FULL_SIGNED_TERNARY_THREE optimum=60 source=8 readouts=52`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The verifier writes nothing and prints its literal word and generated receipt. Historical source pins have no executable predecessor dependency.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The theorem optimizes unit complete-call count within the stated signed one-connector alphabet. Unequal prices, other source counts, coefficient alphabets, output borrowing and additional operations are outside the optimum claim. A constructive unequal-price bill is given without claiming it is optimal.

The all-word conclusion rests on the written proof; the finite runs corroborate it. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No physical consumer, preparation, routing, frames, stock, precision/tape, compiler admission, complete multiplication theorem or selected-frontier improvement is supplied. These costs are unknown and are not assigned zero. No Lean, Docker or selected cold replay was run. No registered local check was deferred to CI.

## Open next questions

1. Determine the all-word optimum for all 80 nonzero ternary rows on four sources, retaining extra-readout alternatives.
2. Determine whether a specified unequal complete-price vector favors a six-source-call path.
3. Identify an actual supplier exposing this demand, then price its maps, ports, setup and full restoration before further construction work.

## Related open work

No open PR found in the refreshed searches studies this exact 26x3 signed characteristic-zero quantity. Nearby connector work has distinct contracts:

- #4079 studies seven-source binary weight-at-most-four demand and a different source-path floor; this uses three sources and all signed ternary rows.
- #3909 adds an atomic four-source operation for five-source binary demand; this keeps individual signed source calls.
- #3897 changes the output alphabet to joint readouts for a one-source/two-output boundary; this retains separate target readouts.

- #5208 proves destination-priced equal-nonunit dirty fanout over commutative rings, with one disjoint source and mutable dirty outputs. It cites this PR but computes no common signed-connector optimum.
- #5211 proves a polynomial-ring two-row single-insertion obstruction and tariff. Its row-addition/source-insertion alphabet differs from this three-source signed connector; no shared numerical quantity is computed.

The post-CLAIM account refresh inspected nine other open PRs created since 2026-10-23 12:26:05 UTC. None studies the same 26x3 signed characteristic-zero optimum; the two adjacent dirty-fanout results are listed above.

Live PRs and handoffs, active Discussions, local reservations, this account's recent PRs, all-main README searches and merged-term searches were checked before claiming and again before committing. The cached helper reports 314 open PRs and 4,389 Discussion records, with incomplete sparse local coverage. These searches do not cover unpublished work or prove novelty. The scientific base and refreshed canonical main remain `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`, priority revision 7. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19145564).

All registered scientific checks, direct normal/optimized replay, metadata and committed-byte/source-history checks also passed locally; no local registered obligation was deferred to CI. Hosted execution is evidence of replay success, not independent human or formal proof-kernel review.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. This adds one research package with an explicit replay manifest and changes no shared code or selected frontier.
